channel_identity.target_audience: Core GTA and Rockstar Games enthusiasts who want sharp, perceptive analysis of Vice City's mechanics, world design, and verified launch milestones.
channel_identity.tone: Knowledgeable insider, observant, concise, grounded, slightly dry wit. Zero hype-screaming or artificial clickbait.
channel_identity.differentiation: Connects small visual details or store milestones to how Rockstar actually engineers open worlds, strictly separating confirmed facts from fan theories.

narrative_rules.hook: Must open with a sharp observation, contrast, or specific anomaly in the first 3 seconds without repeating the raw Reddit post title verbatim.
narrative_rules.body: Must include at least one concrete mechanic, history parallel (e.g., RDR2 or GTA V), or specific visual detail. Must label community theories explicitly.
narrative_rules.payoff: Must conclude with a concrete takeaway answering why the detail matters to the player experience.

banned_phrases: Details like this demonstrate the level of density
Drop your thoughts below and stay tuned
Rockstar hid this in plain sight:
Look at this GTA VI detail:
This shifts how fans are viewing the current timeline
rejected_content_types: verbatim reading of Reddit user comments
